project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler and Tailwind CSS v4
test_framework: No tests configured (no test script in package.json)
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` to confirm the app compiles without errors. Run `npm run lint` to check for linting issues.
environment_constraints: Open internet available. No test framework configured - verification is build + lint only.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing module patterns: seed data in src/data/, storage functions in src/lib/storage.js, state in src/context/AppContext.jsx, page component in src/pages/, sub-components in src/components/<module>/. Use Lucide React icons. Use Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes. Use brand purple #5B2D8E for active/accent states.
key_patterns: Each module follows a tab-based page layout (see PlacementTracker.jsx, Settings.jsx). Page components live in src/pages/. Sub-components in src/components/<module>/. AppContext provides global state with useState + useCallback write-through to localStorage. Seed data functions return initial dataset on first load. The Sidebar NAV_ITEMS array determines navigation order.
directory_structure: src/App.jsx (router), src/pages/ (page components), src/components/<module>/ (sub-components), src/data/ (seed data), src/lib/ (storage, constants, calculations), src/context/ (AppContext global state)
